summary: Frontend-only smoke test of new FundingOrderCompare card on Multi-Year Projection tab. All acceptance criteria pass: card+heading render, empty-state shows default 'Cash → IRA → Taxable → Roth' funding order, Run comparison button triggers Promise.all of two /api/projection runs, table renders with all 6 metric rows, 5 trophy winner icons visible, CURRENT badge correctly attached to depleteIra column (default) and shifts to leaveIra column after switching funding order in ProjectionControls. Regression metrics (metric-lifetime-tax/ending-nw/total-converted/tax-savings) still render. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: FundingOrderCompare.jsx line 137: `fmtUSD(Math.abs(delta) === delta ? delta : delta)` is a no-op — both branches evaluate to `delta`. The intent looks like signed formatting; fmtUSD already handles negatives so the prepended '+' handles the positive case. Simplify to `${delta > 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmtUSD(delta)}` (removes dead ternary).
FundingOrderCompare.jsx uses a bare try/catch that swallows the error object (`catch {}`) — a console.error(e) in dev would help diagnose failed Promise.all runs.

Minor: `runs` is only cleared implicitly on a fresh compare — if user changes funding order the previous comparison table remains stale until Re-run is pressed. Consider resetting `runs` in a useEffect when scenario.withdrawal.funding_order changes, or add a small 'stale' badge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FundingOrderCompare card verified end-to-end on Projection tab. Comparison runs in ~5-10s. Default scenario funding_order = 'Cash → IRA → Taxable → Roth' → CURRENT badge on funding-col-depleteIra. Switching to 'Cash → Taxable → IRA → Roth' via funding-order-select correctly moves badge to funding-col-leaveIra. Regression on other Projection tab elements clean.
